Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where right-clicking on the start screen would cause the lower part of the screen to be displayed infinitely.

Adjustments
Text can now be advanced at the player's preferred timing.

Adjustments
The settings screen can now be closed with the **ESC** key.

Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where pressing the **ESC** key on the settings screen would display the pause menu.
